preconditions.description: The number of vertices n is exactly one more than the number of parent pointers in the list p.
The number of vertices n is between 2 and 100,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= pi < i for i, pi in enumerate(p, start=2))
preconditions.description: Each parent pointer pi is a valid vertex number less than the child vertex i.

postconditions.description: The output is a single integer.
The output is a non-negative integer less than 1,000,000,007.
The output is the number of distinct possible colorings of the tree modulo 1,000,000,007.
